item.title: Socialists target state legislature seats as GOP warns of broader strategy
item.description: At least 65 candidates backed by Democratic Socialists of America are running for state legislature seats, advocating for defunding police and reparations.

item.title: Tech executive responds sharply to critical report on Trump's sons, CNN notes possible foul play
Dick Morris tells Newsmax Fox News Trump coverage boycott harms GOP in midterms
item.description: Political strategist Dick Morris said Saturday on Newsmax that Republicans would fare better in midterms if Fox News covered President Donald Trump.

item.title: Judicial Watch's Thomas Fitton criticizes FBI's gradual release of 75,000 pages in Trump-Butler shooting files
item.description: Thomas Fitton of Judicial Watch calls the FBI's 12-year timeline for releasing documents on the Thomas Matthew Crooks assassination attempt unacceptable.
